name: subroutine
description: Project management for people and agents, in equal measure.

plugins.name: subroutine
plugins.description: Give Claude a shared, durable task list: file work, find what is ready, record what happened, and leave the next session something to read. This one starts Subroutine as a program on your own machine, so it works in Claude Code and the desktop apps and not on the web. Needs Subroutine installed separately and on your PATH — 'uv tool install subroutine' or 'pipx install subroutine', then 'subroutine init'. If your work lives on a server somebody else runs, install 'subroutine-remote' instead.

plugins.name: subroutine-remote
plugins.description: The same shared task list, against a Subroutine instance somebody else runs. Paste the address and the token you were given and you are working — nothing to install and no configuration file to edit. Your editor connects from this machine, so a server on your own network or behind a VPN works as readily as a public one. Like every Claude Code plugin it runs in the editor and the desktop apps and not on the web; to reach an instance from claude.ai, add it there as a connector instead. Install 'subroutine' if the work lives on this machine.
